source.text: נִדְרַ֨שְׁתִּי֙ לְל֣וֹא שָׁאָ֔לוּ נִמְצֵ֖אתִי לְלֹ֣א בִקְשֻׁ֑נִי אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ הִנֵּ֣נִי הִנֵּ֔נִי אֶל־גּ֖וֹי לֹֽא־קֹרָ֥א בִשְׁמִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: I let myself be sought by [those who] did not ask; I let myself be found by [those who] did not seek me; I said, here I [am], here I [am], to a nation [that] was not called by my name.

en.L: I let {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} be sought by [those who] did not ask; \q I let {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} be found by [those who] did not seek {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q I said, "Here I [am], here I [am]," \q to a nation [that] was not called by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.
en.B: I made {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} available to those who did not ask; \q I let {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} be found by people who were not looking for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q "Here I am, here I am," I said \q to a nation that did not bear {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.
en.R: I was ready to answer people who never came to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} with questions. \q I let people find {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, though they were not looking for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q I said, "I am here! I am here!" \q to a nation that was not known as {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}.

es.L: Me dejé consultar por [los que] no preguntaban; \q me dejé hallar por [los que] no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} buscaban. \q Dije: «Aquí [estoy], aquí [estoy]», \q a una nación [que] no era llamada por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre.
es.B: Me puse al alcance de los que no preguntaban por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; \q me dejé encontrar por gente que no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} buscaba. \q «Aquí estoy, aquí estoy», le dije \q a una nación que no llevaba {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre.
es.R: Estaba listo para responder a gente que nunca vino a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} con preguntas. \q Dejé que la gente {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} encontrara, aunque no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} estaban buscando. \q Dije: «¡Aquí estoy! ¡Aquí estoy!» \q a una nación que no era conocida como {{deity_pronoun:mía|Mía}}.

sw.L: Nilijiacha nitafutwe na [wale] wasioniuliza; \q nilijiacha nionekane na [wale] wasionitafuta. \q Nilisema, "Mimi hapa, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} hapa," \q kwa taifa [ambalo] halikuitwa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.B: Nilijiweka tayari kwa wale wasioniuliza; \q niliwaacha wanipate watu ambao hawakuwa wakinitafuta. \q "Niko hapa, niko hapa," nilisema \q kwa taifa ambalo halikubeba jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.
sw.R: Nilikuwa tayari kuwajibu watu ambao hawakuwahi kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} na maswali. \q Niliwaacha watu wanipate, ingawa hawakuwa wakinitafuta. \q Nilisema, "Niko hapa! Niko hapa!" \q kwa taifa ambalo halikujulikana kuwa ni {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.

decisions.choice: I let myself be sought, I let myself be found: God made himself available
decisions.reason: The verb forms mean God allowed himself to be consulted and found. He was ready to answer, even though no one came (compare 55:6, where people are told to seek him while he may be found).

decisions.choice: quoted in Romans 10:20-21
decisions.reason: Paul quotes verse 1 of the Gentiles, who found God without seeking him, and verse 2 of Israel. In Isaiah verse 2 goes on to describe a rebellious people, so verse 1 may describe the same people: God was ready to answer Israel, though Israel did not seek him.

decisions.choice: not called by my name: the Hebrew text is followed
alternatives: that did not call on my name
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says the nation "was not called by my name", that is, was not known as God's own (63:19). The Septuagint has "did not call on my name", which needs only different vowels. The sense is close either way.

decisions.choice: never came to me with questions; was not known as mine
decisions.reason: Readable explains "ask" as coming to God for an answer and "called by my name" as belonging to him.

decisions.choice: me dejé hallar por los que no me buscaban
decisions.reason: Romans 10:20 quotes this verse; Spanish keeps its key words ("hallar", "los que no me buscaban") while following the Hebrew verb forms ("me dejé").

decisions.choice: nilijiacha nitafutwe ... nionekane
decisions.reason: Romans 10:20 quotes the verse; the Swahili keeps the sense of God letting himself be found, worded from the Hebrew, which speaks of a nation not called by God's name (meaning decision m3).

source.text: פֵּרַ֧שְׂתִּי יָדַ֛י כָּל־הַיּ֖וֹם אֶל־עַ֣ם סוֹרֵ֑ר הַהֹלְכִים֙ הַדֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא־ט֔וֹב אַחַ֖ר מַחְשְׁבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: I spread out my hands all the day to a rebellious people, who walk [in] the way [that is] not good, after their thoughts,

en.L: I spread out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands all the day to a rebellious people, \q who walk [in] the way [that is] not good, \q after their [own] thoughts,
en.B: The whole day through I stretched out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands to a defiant people, \q who go along a road that is no good, \q wherever their own plans lead them,
en.R: All day long I held out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands to welcome them, but they are a people who turn against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q They live in a way that is not good \q and follow their own ideas.

es.L: Extendí {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos todo el día a un pueblo rebelde, \q que anda [por] el camino [que] no es bueno, \q en pos de sus [propios] pensamientos,
es.B: Todo el día extendí {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos hacia un pueblo desafiante, \q que va por un camino que no es bueno, \q adondequiera que lo lleven sus propios planes,
es.R: Todo el día extendí {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos para recibirlos, pero son un pueblo que se vuelve contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Viven de una manera que no es buena \q y siguen sus propias ideas.

sw.L: Nimeinyoosha mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} mchana kutwa kwa watu waasi, \q wanaotembea [katika] njia [isiyo] njema, \q wakifuata mawazo yao [wenyewe],
sw.B: Mchana kutwa niliwanyooshea mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} watu wakaidi, \q wanaofuata njia isiyofaa, \q popote mipango yao wenyewe inapowapeleka,
sw.R: Mchana kutwa niliwanyooshea mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kuwakaribisha, lakini wao ni watu wanaoniasi. \q Wanaishi kwa njia isiyo njema \q na kufuata mawazo yao wenyewe.

decisions.choice: I spread out my hands: God pleads and invites, like someone reaching out to another
decisions.reason: Spread hands are a gesture of appeal, used of prayer (1:15) and of wisdom calling those who will not listen (Proverbs 1:24). Here God is the one who pleads.

decisions.choice: rebellious: stubbornly defiant
decisions.reason: The word describes the son who will not obey his parents (Deuteronomy 21:18) and Israel in Psalm 78:8. Romans 10:21 quotes the verse of Israel.

decisions.choice: to welcome them
decisions.reason: Readable says what the spread hands mean (m1).

source.text: הָעָ֗ם הַמַּכְעִיסִ֥ים אוֹתִ֛י עַל־פָּנַ֖י תָּמִ֑יד זֹֽבְחִים֙ בַּגַּנּ֔וֹת וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים עַל־הַלְּבֵנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: the people who provoke me to anger on my face continually, who sacrifice in the gardens and make smoke on the bricks,

en.L: the people who provoke {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to anger to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face continually, \q sacrificing in the gardens \q and burning incense on the bricks,
en.B: a people who are always angering {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, right before {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face; \q they sacrifice in gardens \q and burn incense on bricks,
en.R: These people are always making {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry right in front of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q They offer sacrifices to idols in gardens, \q and they burn incense on brick altars.

es.L: el pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} provoca a ira en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} cara continuamente, \q que sacrifica en los huertos \q y quema incienso sobre los ladrillos,
es.B: un pueblo que siempre {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} está provocando, delante de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} propia cara; \q ofrecen sacrificios en huertos \q y queman incienso sobre ladrillos,
es.R: Esta gente siempre {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} está haciendo enojar justo delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Ofrecen sacrificios a los ídolos en huertos, \q y queman incienso sobre altares de ladrillo.

sw.L: watu wanaonikasirisha usoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} daima, \q wakitoa dhabihu katika bustani \q na kufukiza uvumba juu ya matofali,
sw.B: watu wanaonikasirisha siku zote, mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}; \q wanatoa dhabihu bustanini \q na kufukiza uvumba juu ya matofali,
sw.R: Watu hawa wananikasirisha kila mara mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Wanatoa dhabihu kwa sanamu katika bustani, \q nao wanafukiza uvumba juu ya madhabahu ya matofali.

decisions.choice: sacrificing in gardens: worship of other gods in sacred groves
decisions.reason: Gardens were places of idol worship (1:29; 66:17). The people offer there what belongs to God alone.

decisions.choice: burning incense on bricks: offerings on brick altars or rooftop tiles
decisions.reason: God's altar was to be made of earth or uncut stone (Exodus 20:24-25). Bricks may be altars of that forbidden kind, or the tiles of flat roofs where incense was burned to other gods (Jeremiah 19:13).

decisions.choice: to my face: openly, in God's very presence
decisions.reason: They do it without shame, as if before his eyes (Job 1:11).

decisions.choice: to idols; brick altars
decisions.reason: Readable says to whom the sacrifices go and what the bricks are, following m1 and m2.

source.text: הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בַּקְּבָרִ֔ים וּבַנְּצוּרִ֖ים יָלִ֑ינוּ הָאֹֽכְלִים֙ בְּשַׂ֣ר הַחֲזִ֔יר וּמְרַ֥ק פִּגֻּלִ֖ים כְּלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: who sit among graves and spend the night in the guarded [places], who eat the flesh of the pig, and broth of foul [meats] [is in] their vessels,

en.L: who sit among the graves \q and spend the night in the hidden places, \q who eat the flesh of the pig, \q and broth of foul [meat is in] their vessels,
en.B: who sit among the tombs \q and spend the night in hidden spots, \q who eat the meat of pigs, \q with a stew of foul meat in their pots,
en.R: They sit among the graves \q and spend the night in secret places to seek the spirits of the dead. \q They eat pork, \q and their pots are full of soup made from unclean meat.

es.L: que se sientan entre los sepulcros \q y pasan la noche en lugares escondidos, \q que comen carne de cerdo, \q y caldo de [carnes] inmundas [hay en] sus vasijas,
es.B: que se sientan entre las tumbas \q y pasan la noche en rincones ocultos, \q que comen carne de cerdo, \q con un guiso de carne impura en sus ollas,
es.R: Se sientan entre las tumbas \q y pasan la noche en lugares secretos para consultar a los espíritus de los muertos. \q Comen carne de cerdo, \q y sus ollas están llenas de sopa hecha con carne impura.

sw.L: wanaoketi kati ya makaburi \q na kulala usiku mahali palipofichika, \q wanaokula nyama ya nguruwe, \q na mchuzi wa [nyama] chafu [umo] vyomboni mwao,
sw.B: wanaoketi makaburini \q na kukesha usiku mahali pa siri, \q wanaokula nyama ya nguruwe, \q huku mchuzi wa nyama chafu ukiwa katika vyungu vyao,
sw.R: Wanaketi kati ya makaburi \q na kulala usiku mahali pa siri wakitafuta roho za wafu. \q Wanakula nyama ya nguruwe, \q na vyungu vyao vimejaa mchuzi wa nyama iliyo najisi.

decisions.choice: sitting among graves, spending the night in hidden places: seeking the dead or rites done at night
decisions.reason: The law forbade asking the dead for guidance (Deuteronomy 18:11; 8:19). Sitting in tombs and keeping watch through the night point to such practices. The word for the places means "guarded" or "hidden".

decisions.choice: the flesh of the pig: food the law forbade
decisions.reason: Pigs were unclean under the law (Leviticus 11:7; Deuteronomy 14:8). Eating pork belongs with the false worship again in 66:17.

decisions.choice: broth of foul meat: the reading of the margin (qere)
decisions.reason: The margin reads "broth"; the written text (ketiv) has a word for "pieces". The sense is much the same. The word "foul" is used of sacrificial meat left too long, which must not be eaten (Leviticus 7:18; 19:7).

decisions.choice: to seek the spirits of the dead
decisions.reason: Readable says why they spend the night in tombs, following m1.

source.text: הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ קְרַ֣ב אֵלֶ֔יךָ אַל־תִּגַּשׁ־בִּ֖י כִּ֣י קְדַשְׁתִּ֑יךָ אֵ֚לֶּה עָשָׁ֣ן בְּאַפִּ֔י אֵ֥שׁ יֹקֶ֖דֶת כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: who say, Draw near to yourself, do not come near me, for I am holy [to] you. These [are] smoke in my nose, a fire burning all the day.

en.L: who say, "Keep to yourself; \q do not come near me, for I am holy [beyond] you." \q These [are] smoke in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} nose, \q a fire burning all the day.
en.B: who say, "Keep your distance; \q do not come close to me, for I am holier than you." \q These people are smoke in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} nose, \q a fire that burns on all day long.
en.R: They say to others, "Stay away from me! \q Do not come near me. I am too holy for you." \q These people make {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} angry all the time, \q like smoke that stings {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} nose and a fire that never stops burning.

es.L: que dicen: «Quédate en tu lugar; \q no te acerques a mí, porque soy más santo que tú». \q Estos [son] humo en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nariz, \q fuego que arde todo el día.
es.B: que dicen: «Mantén tu distancia; \q no te me acerques, porque soy más santo que tú». \q Esta gente es humo en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nariz, \q un fuego que arde todo el día.
es.R: Les dicen a otros: «¡Aléjate de mí! \q No te me acerques. Soy demasiado santo para ti». \q Esta gente {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} hace enojar todo el tiempo, \q como humo que irrita {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nariz y un fuego que nunca deja de arder.

sw.L: wanaosema, "Jiweke peke yako; \q usinikaribie, kwa maana mimi ni mtakatifu [kuliko] wewe." \q Hawa [ni] moshi katika pua {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, \q moto uwakao mchana kutwa.
sw.B: wanaosema, "Kaa mbali; \q usinisogelee, kwa maana mimi ni mtakatifu kuliko wewe." \q Watu hawa ni moshi katika pua {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, \q moto unaoendelea kuwaka mchana kutwa.
sw.R: Wanawaambia wengine, "Kaeni mbali nami! \q Msinikaribie. Mimi ni mtakatifu mno kwenu." \q Watu hawa wananikasirisha kila mara, \q kama moshi unaouma pua {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na moto usiozimika kamwe.

decisions.choice: I am holy to you: I am too holy for you to touch
decisions.reason: The idol worshipers claim a holiness that others must not come near. With other vowels the word could mean "I would make you holy", that is, my holiness would pass to you by touch (compare Ezekiel 44:19).

decisions.choice: smoke in my nose: a constant offense that keeps God's anger burning
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the nose is the seat of anger. Their smoke, unlike the pleasing smell of true offerings (Leviticus 1:9), only provokes him.

decisions.choice: make me angry all the time
decisions.reason: Readable states what the smoke in God's nose means (m2) and keeps the picture.

source.text: הִנֵּ֥ה כְתוּבָ֖ה לְפָנָ֑י לֹ֤א אֶחֱשֶׂה֙ כִּ֣י אִם־שִׁלַּ֔מְתִּי וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֖י עַל־חֵיקָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, [it is] written before me; I will not be silent, but I will repay, and I will repay into their bosom,

en.L: Look, [it is] written before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}: \q I will not be silent, but I will repay, \q and I will repay into their bosom,
en.B: Look, it is on record before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q I will not stay silent; instead I will repay, \q repaying them straight into their laps,
en.R: Look, everything they have done is written down in front of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q I will not stay silent. \q I will pay them back in full.

es.L: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, [está] escrito delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}: \q no callaré, sino que pagaré, \q y pagaré en su seno,
es.B: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, consta delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q No me quedaré callado; al contrario, les pagaré, \q y les pagaré directamente en su regazo,
es.R: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, todo lo que han hecho está escrito delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q No me quedaré callado. \q Les pagaré por completo.

sw.L: Tazama, [imeandikwa] mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}: \q Sitanyamaza, bali nitalipa, \q naam, nitalipa vifuani mwao,
sw.B: Tazama, yameandikwa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Sitakaa kimya; badala yake nitalipa, \q nikiwalipa moja kwa moja mapajani mwao,
sw.R: Tazama, kila kitu walichofanya kimeandikwa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Sitanyamaza. \q Nitawalipa kikamilifu.

decisions.choice: written before me: a record of their deeds
decisions.reason: God keeps a record of what people do (Malachi 3:16; Psalm 56:9; Daniel 7:10). Nothing is forgotten.

decisions.choice: I will not be silent: God's answer to the prayer's question
decisions.reason: The prayer ended "Will you be silent?" (64:11). God answers that he will not be silent, but for those who keep rebelling, his answer is judgment.

decisions.choice: repay into their bosom: pay back in full
decisions.reason: The fold of the robe at the chest served as a pocket; payment was poured into it (Jeremiah 32:18; Psalm 79:12; Luke 6:38).

decisions.choice: everything they have done
decisions.reason: Readable says what is written, following m1.

source.text: עֲ֠וֺנֹתֵיכֶם וַעֲוֺנֹ֨ת אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֤ם יַחְדָּו֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִטְּרוּ֙ עַל־הֶ֣הָרִ֔ים וְעַל־הַגְּבָע֖וֹת חֵרְפ֑וּנִי וּמַדֹּתִ֧י פְעֻלָּתָ֛ם רִֽאשֹׁנָ֖ה אֶל־חֵיקָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: your iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together, says Yahweh, who made smoke on the mountains and on the hills taunted me, and I will measure their wage first into their bosom.

en.L: your iniquities and the iniquities of your fathers together, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q who burned incense on the mountains \q and taunted {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on the hills; \q and I will measure their former wage into their bosom.
en.B: for your guilt and the guilt of your ancestors as well, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q They made offerings smoke on the mountains \q and mocked {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on the hills, \q so I will measure out what their past deeds have earned and pour it into their laps.
en.R: I will punish your sins and the sins of your ancestors too, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q They burned incense to false gods on the mountains and insulted {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on the hills. \q So I will pay them back in full for what they did in the past.

es.L: {{plural_you:sus iniquidades y las iniquidades de sus padres|vuestras iniquidades y las iniquidades de vuestros padres}} juntamente, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q que quemaron incienso sobre los montes \q y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} afrentaron sobre los collados; \q y mediré su paga anterior en su seno.
es.B: por {{plural_you:su culpa y la culpa de sus antepasados|vuestra culpa y la culpa de vuestros antepasados}} también, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Ellos quemaron ofrendas sobre los montes \q y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ofendieron sobre las colinas, \q así que mediré lo que sus obras pasadas han ganado y lo derramaré en su regazo.
es.R: Castigaré {{plural_you:sus pecados y los pecados de sus antepasados|vuestros pecados y los pecados de vuestros antepasados}} también, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Quemaron incienso a dioses falsos en los montes y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} insultaron en las colinas. \q Así que les pagaré por completo por lo que hicieron en el pasado.

sw.L: maovu yenu na maovu ya baba zenu pamoja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q waliofukiza uvumba juu ya milima \q na kunitukana juu ya vilima; \q nami nitawapimia ujira wao wa kwanza vifuani mwao.
sw.B: kwa ajili ya hatia yenu na hatia ya babu zenu pia, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Walifukiza sadaka juu ya milima \q na kunidhihaki juu ya vilima, \q kwa hiyo nitawapimia kile ambacho matendo yao ya zamani yamestahili na kukimimina mapajani mwao.
sw.R: Nitaziadhibu dhambi zenu na dhambi za babu zenu pia, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Walifukiza uvumba kwa miungu ya uongo juu ya milima na kunitukana juu ya vilima. \q Kwa hiyo nitawalipa kikamilifu kwa yale waliyoyafanya zamani.

decisions.choice: your iniquities ... their wage: the speech turns between "you" and "them"
decisions.reason: God turns from speaking about the rebels (verse 6) to speaking to them and back again. The same people are meant. The sins of the fathers and the children are paid together (Exodus 20:5).

decisions.choice: incense on the mountains and hills: worship at the high places
decisions.reason: Hilltop shrines to other gods were common in Israel and Judah (57:7; Hosea 4:13; 2 Kings 17:10-11).

decisions.choice: their wage first: payment for their former deeds
alternatives: I will measure out their wage first
decisions.reason: The word "first" agrees with "wage" (or "work"), so it is read as their former work, the deeds of the past. Some take it as "first of all", before anything else.

decisions.choice: to false gods
decisions.reason: Readable says whom the incense was for, following m2.

source.text: כֹּ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִמָּצֵ֤א הַתִּירוֹשׁ֙ בָּֽאֶשְׁכּ֔וֹל וְאָמַר֙ אַל־תַּשְׁחִיתֵ֔הוּ כִּ֥י בְרָכָ֖ה בּ֑וֹ כֵּ֤ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ לְמַ֣עַן עֲבָדַ֔י לְבִלְתִּ֖י הַֽשְׁחִ֥ית הַכֹּֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: As the new wine is found in the cluster and [one] says, Do not destroy it, for a blessing [is] in it, so I will do for the sake of my servants, not to destroy the whole.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: As the new wine is found in the cluster, \q and [someone] says, "Do not destroy it, for a blessing [is] in it," \q so I will do for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants, \q so as not to destroy the whole.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: As long as new wine can be found in a bunch of grapes, \q people say, "Leave it whole, for there is blessing in it." \q I will do the same for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants' sake: \q I will not destroy everything.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: When people find good juice in a bunch of grapes, \q they say, "Do not throw it away. There is still something good in it." \q In the same way, I will not destroy the whole nation, because of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Como cuando se halla mosto en el racimo, \q y [alguien] dice: «No lo destruyas, porque hay bendición en él», \q así haré yo por amor de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos, \q para no destruirlo todo.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Mientras se pueda hallar mosto en un racimo de uvas, \q la gente dice: «Déjalo entero, porque hay bendición en él». \q Así haré yo por amor de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos: \q no lo destruiré todo.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Cuando la gente encuentra buen jugo en un racimo de uvas, \q dice: «No lo tires. Todavía tiene algo bueno». \q De la misma manera, no destruiré a toda la nación, por amor de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kama divai mpya ionekanavyo katika kishada, \q na [mtu] asema, "Usikiharibu, kwa maana mna baraka ndani yake," \q ndivyo nitakavyofanya kwa ajili ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q nisiwaangamize wote.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Maadamu divai mpya inapatikana katika kishada cha zabibu, \q watu husema, "Kiacheni kizima, kwa maana mna baraka ndani yake." \q Ndivyo nitakavyofanya kwa ajili ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}: \q sitaangamiza kila kitu.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Watu wanapopata maji mazuri katika kishada cha zabibu, \q husema, "Msikitupe. Bado kuna kitu kizuri ndani yake." \q Vivyo hivyo, sitaliangamiza taifa zima, kwa sababu ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.

decisions.choice: new wine in the cluster: some good remains in a spoiled harvest, so the whole is spared
decisions.reason: A cluster with a little juice in it is kept. So God will spare Israel for the sake of the faithful within it, the remnant (6:13; 10:20-22).

decisions.choice: do not destroy it: perhaps a saying or a song of the vintage
decisions.reason: The words "Do not destroy" stand in the titles of Psalms 57, 58, 59 and 75, probably naming a tune. The saying here may come from the grape harvest.

decisions.choice: my servants: the faithful within Israel
decisions.reason: From here on "servants" is plural and means those who stay true to God, set against those who forsake him (verses 9, 13-15; 54:17).

decisions.choice: the whole nation
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the whole" is.

source.text: וְהוֹצֵאתִ֤י מִֽיַּעֲקֹב֙ זֶ֔רַע וּמִיהוּדָ֖ה יוֹרֵ֣שׁ הָרָ֑י וִירֵשׁ֣וּהָ בְחִירַ֔י וַעֲבָדַ֖י יִשְׁכְּנוּ־שָֽׁמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will bring out from Jacob offspring, and from Judah an heir of my mountains, and my chosen ones will possess it, and my servants will dwell there.

en.L: And I will bring out offspring from Jacob, \q and from Judah an heir of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mountains; \q and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} chosen ones will possess it, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants will dwell there.
en.B: From Jacob I will bring out a line of descendants, \q and from Judah people to inherit {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mountains. \q My chosen ones will take possession of it, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants will make their home there.
en.R: I will give the families of Jacob and Judah children who will own the land in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mountains. \q The people I have chosen will own it, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants will live there.

es.L: Y sacaré de Jacob descendencia, \q y de Judá un heredero de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} montes; \q y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} escogidos la poseerán, y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos habitarán allí.
es.B: De Jacob sacaré un linaje, \q y de Judá gente que herede {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} montes. \q Mis escogidos tomarán posesión de ella, y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos harán allí su hogar.
es.R: Les daré a las familias de Jacob y de Judá hijos que serán dueños de la tierra en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} montes. \q La gente que he escogido será dueña de ella, y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos vivirán allí.

sw.L: Nami nitatoa uzao kutoka kwa Yakobo, \q na kutoka kwa Yuda mrithi wa milima {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; \q na wateule {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wataimiliki, na watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watakaa huko.
sw.B: Kutoka kwa Yakobo nitaleta ukoo wa wazao, \q na kutoka kwa Yuda watu wa kurithi milima {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Wateule {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wataimiliki, na watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watafanya makao yao huko.
sw.R: Nitazipa jamaa za Yakobo na Yuda watoto watakaomiliki nchi katika milima {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Watu niliowachagua wataimiliki, na watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wataishi huko.

decisions.choice: my mountains: the hill country of Israel, God's land
decisions.reason: The land is called God's mountains (14:25; Ezekiel 38:21). "It" is the land.

decisions.choice: an heir: those who will inherit, one people
decisions.reason: The word is singular but stands for the group that will inherit, as "offspring" does.

source.text: וְהָיָ֤ה הַשָּׁרוֹן֙ לִנְוֵה־צֹ֔אן וְעֵ֥מֶק עָכ֖וֹר לְרֵ֣בֶץ בָּקָ֑ר לְעַמִּ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר דְּרָשֽׁוּנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And Sharon will become a pasture of flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place of cattle, for my people who have sought me.

en.L: And Sharon will become a pasture of flocks, \q and [the] Valley of Achor a resting place of cattle, \q for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people who have sought {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: The plain of Sharon will become grazing land for sheep and goats, \q and the Valley of Achor a place where herds lie down, \q for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people who have sought {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: The plain of Sharon in the west will be a field where sheep can eat grass. \q The Valley of Achor in the east will be a place where cattle can rest. \q This will be for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people who have turned to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Y Sarón será pastizal de ovejas, \q y el valle de Acor lugar de descanso para el ganado, \q para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha buscado.
es.B: La llanura de Sarón se convertirá en pastizal para las ovejas y las cabras, \q y el valle de Acor en un lugar donde se echa el ganado, \q para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha buscado.
es.R: La llanura de Sarón, en el occidente, será un campo donde las ovejas puedan comer pasto. \q El valle de Acor, en el oriente, será un lugar donde el ganado pueda descansar. \q Esto será para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, que se ha vuelto a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.

sw.L: Na Sharoni itakuwa malisho ya makundi, \q na Bonde la Akori mahali pa kupumzika ng'ombe, \q kwa ajili ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} walionitafuta.
sw.B: Uwanda wa Sharoni utakuwa malisho ya kondoo na mbuzi, \q na Bonde la Akori mahali ambapo makundi ya ng'ombe hulala, \q kwa ajili ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} walionitafuta.
sw.R: Uwanda wa Sharoni upande wa magharibi utakuwa shamba ambapo kondoo wanaweza kula majani. \q Bonde la Akori upande wa mashariki litakuwa mahali ambapo ng'ombe wanaweza kupumzika. \q Hili litakuwa kwa ajili ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} walionigeukia.

decisions.choice: Sharon and Achor: from the western plain to a valley in the east, the whole land
decisions.reason: Sharon is the coastal plain (33:9; 35:2). The Valley of Achor, "trouble", lies near Jericho, where Achan was put to death (Joshua 7:24-26). Hosea 2:17 (in the Hebrew numbering; 2:15 elsewhere) promises it will become a door of hope.

decisions.choice: who have sought me: who turn to God in worship and trust
decisions.reason: To seek the LORD is to turn to him (55:6; Deuteronomy 4:29). It stands against those who did not seek him (verse 1).

decisions.choice: the plain of; sheep and goats; in the west; in the east
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what Sharon is and what a flock is; Readable gives where the two places lie (m1).

source.text: וְאַתֶּם֙ עֹזְבֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה הַשְּׁכֵחִ֖ים אֶת־הַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֑י הַֽעֹרְכִ֤ים לַגַּד֙ שֻׁלְחָ֔ן וְהַֽמְמַלְאִ֖ים לַמְנִ֥י מִמְסָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, forsakers of Yahweh, the forgetting of my holy mountain, who arrange for Gad a table and who fill for Meni mixed wine,

en.L: But you, forsakers of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q who forget the mountain of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holiness, \q who arrange a table for Gad \q and who fill mixed wine for Meni,
en.B: But you who turn away from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q who have forgotten {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain, \q who lay a table for Gad \q and fill cups of mixed wine for Meni,
en.R: But some of you have left {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and forgotten {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain, Zion. \q You set out food for Gad, the god of good luck, \q and pour wine for Meni, the god of fate.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes, los que abandonan|vosotros, los que abandonáis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q {{plural_you:los que olvidan|los que olvidáis}} el monte de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santidad, \q {{plural_you:los que ponen|los que ponéis}} mesa para Gad \q y {{plural_you:llenan|llenáis}} vino mezclado para Mení,
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes que se apartan|vosotros que os apartáis}} {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q que {{plural_you:han olvidado|habéis olvidado}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santo monte, \q que {{plural_you:preparan|preparáis}} una mesa para Gad \q y {{plural_you:llenan|llenáis}} copas de vino mezclado para Mení,
es.R: Pero algunos de {{plural_you:ustedes han dejado|vosotros habéis dejado}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:han olvidado|habéis olvidado}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santo monte, Sion. \q {{plural_you:Le sirven|Le servís}} comida a Gad, el dios de la buena suerte, \q y {{plural_you:le sirven|le servís}} vino a Mení, el dios del destino.

sw.L: Lakini ninyi, mnaomwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q mnaousahau mlima wa utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q mnaomwandalia Gadi meza \q na mnaomjazia Meni divai iliyochanganywa,
sw.B: Lakini ninyi mnaomwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q mliousahau mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu, \q mnaomwandalia Gadi meza \q na kumjazia Meni vikombe vya divai iliyochanganywa,
sw.R: Lakini baadhi yenu mmemwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuusahau mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu, Sayuni. \q Mnamwekea chakula Gadi, mungu wa bahati njema, \q na kummiminia divai Meni, mungu wa majaliwa.

decisions.choice: Gad and Meni: gods of fortune and destiny
decisions.reason: Gad was worshiped as a god of good luck; the place names Baal-gad and Migdal-gad keep his name (Joshua 11:17; 15:37). Meni comes from a verb meaning to count or allot, so the name means fate or destiny. The names are kept; some render them "Fortune" and "Destiny".

decisions.choice: a table and mixed wine: a meal set out for the gods
decisions.reason: Food and drink were laid out for gods as an act of worship (Jeremiah 7:18; 1 Corinthians 10:21). Mixed wine was wine blended with spices or water.

decisions.choice: Zion; the god of good luck; the god of fate
decisions.reason: Readable names the holy mountain and says who Gad and Meni were (m1).

decisions.choice: Gad; Mení
decisions.reason: The names of the two gods of fortune and destiny are kept; Readable says who they were, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Gadi; Meni
decisions.reason: The gods of fortune and destiny (meaning decision m1) keep their names; Gad the god is spelled as Gad the tribe, and Readable says who they were.

source.text: וּמָנִ֨יתִי אֶתְכֶ֜ם לַחֶ֗רֶב וְכֻלְּכֶם֙ לַטֶּ֣בַח תִּכְרָ֔עוּ יַ֤עַן קָרָ֨אתִי֙ וְלֹ֣א עֲנִיתֶ֔ם דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וַתַּעֲשׂ֤וּ הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינַ֔י וּבַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־חָפַ֖צְתִּי בְּחַרְתֶּֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: and I will destine you to the sword, and all of you will bow down to the slaughter, because I called and you did not answer, I spoke and you did not listen, and you did the evil in my eyes, and [that] which I did not delight in you chose.

en.L: and I will destine you to the sword, and all of you will bow down to the slaughter, \q because I called and you did not answer, \q I spoke and you did not listen, \q and you did the evil in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes, \q and what I did not delight in you chose.
en.B: I will mark you out for the sword, and all of you will kneel down to be slaughtered. \q When I called, you gave no answer; \q when I spoke, you paid no attention. \q You did what is evil in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight \q and chose the very things I take no pleasure in.
en.R: So I will decide your fate: you will die by the sword. All of you will bow down to be killed. \q This is because I called you, but you did not answer. \q I spoke to you, but you did not listen. \q You did things that I consider evil, \q and you chose what does not please {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: yo {{plural_you:los|os}} destinaré a la espada, y todos {{plural_you:ustedes se inclinarán|vosotros os inclinaréis}} para el degüello, \q porque llamé y no {{plural_you:respondieron|respondisteis}}, \q hablé y no {{plural_you:escucharon|escuchasteis}}, \q sino que {{plural_you:hicieron|hicisteis}} lo malo ante {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos, \q y {{plural_you:escogieron|escogisteis}} lo que no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} agrada.
es.B: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} destinaré a la espada, y todos {{plural_you:ustedes se arrodillarán|vosotros os arrodillaréis}} para ser degollados. \q Cuando llamé, no {{plural_you:dieron|disteis}} respuesta; \q cuando hablé, no {{plural_you:prestaron|prestasteis}} atención. \q {{plural_you:Hicieron|Hicisteis}} lo que es malo a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos \q y {{plural_you:escogieron|escogisteis}} precisamente lo que no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} agrada.
es.R: Así que yo decidiré {{plural_you:su destino|vuestro destino}}: {{plural_you:morirán|moriréis}} a espada. Todos {{plural_you:ustedes se inclinarán|vosotros os inclinaréis}} para que {{plural_you:los|os}} maten. \q Esto es porque {{plural_you:los|os}} llamé, pero no {{plural_you:respondieron|respondisteis}}. \q {{plural_you:Les|Os}} hablé, pero no {{plural_you:escucharon|escuchasteis}}. \q {{plural_you:Hicieron|Hicisteis}} cosas que yo considero malas, \q y {{plural_you:escogieron|escogisteis}} lo que no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} agrada.

sw.L: nami nitawaandikia upanga, na nyote mtainama kwa kuchinjwa, \q kwa sababu niliita wala hamkujibu, \q nilisema wala hamkusikiliza, \q nanyi mlitenda maovu machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}, \q na lile nisilolipenda mlilichagua.
sw.B: Nitawatenga kwa ajili ya upanga, na nyote mtapiga magoti ili kuchinjwa. \q Nilipoita, hamkujibu; \q niliposema, hamkujali. \q Mlitenda yaliyo maovu machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} \q na kuyachagua mambo yale ambayo sipendezwi nayo.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nitaamua majaliwa yenu: mtakufa kwa upanga. Nyote mtainama ili mchinjwe. \q Hii ni kwa sababu niliwaita, lakini hamkujibu. \q Nilisema nanyi, lakini hamkusikiliza. \q Mlitenda mambo ambayo ninayaona kuwa maovu, \q na mkachagua yasiyonipendeza.

decisions.choice: I will destine you: a play on the name Meni
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the same root as Meni, the god of destiny (verse 11). The fate they sought from Meni, God himself will allot: the sword.

decisions.choice: bow down to the slaughter: kneel like animals to be killed
decisions.reason: Those who bowed to idols will bow under the sword (compare 10:4).

decisions.choice: I called and you did not answer: repeated in 66:4
decisions.reason: The same charge comes in 66:4 and 50:2. It is the reverse of 65:24, where God answers before his servants call.

decisions.choice: decide your fate: you will die by the sword
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the play on fate (m1) and says what destining to the sword means.

decisions.choice: destinaré; destino
decisions.reason: The verb plays on the name Mení, the god of destiny (verse 11); Spanish keeps the play with "destinar" and, at Readable, "destino".

decisions.choice: nitaamua majaliwa yenu
decisions.reason: "I will destine you" plays on Meni, the god of destiny (meaning decision m1); Readable keeps the play with "majaliwa", the word used for Meni in verse 11.

source.text: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר׀אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה עֲבָדַ֤י׀יֹאכֵ֨לוּ֙ וְאַתֶּ֣ם תִּרְעָ֔בוּ הִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדַ֛י יִשְׁתּ֖וּ וְאַתֶּ֣ם תִּצְמָ֑אוּ הִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדַ֛י יִשְׂמָ֖חוּ וְאַתֶּ֥ם תֵּבֹֽשׁוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Look, my servants will eat, and you will be hungry; look, my servants will drink, and you will be thirsty; look, my servants will rejoice, and you will be ashamed.

en.L: Therefore thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Look, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants will eat, and you will be hungry; \q look, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants will drink, and you will be thirsty; \q look, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants will rejoice, and you will be ashamed.
en.B: So the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: See, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants will eat while you go hungry. \q See, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants will drink while you are thirsty. \q See, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants will be glad while you hang your heads in shame.
en.R: So this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: My servants will have food, but you will be hungry. \q My servants will have drink, but you will be thirsty. \q My servants will be glad, but you will be ashamed.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos comerán, y {{plural_you:ustedes tendrán|vosotros tendréis}} hambre; \q {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos beberán, y {{plural_you:ustedes tendrán|vosotros tendréis}} sed; \q {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos se alegrarán, y {{plural_you:ustedes serán avergonzados|vosotros seréis avergonzados}}.
es.B: Por eso el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos comerán mientras {{plural_you:ustedes pasan|vosotros pasáis}} hambre. \q {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos beberán mientras {{plural_you:ustedes tienen|vosotros tenéis}} sed. \q {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos se alegrarán mientras {{plural_you:ustedes agachan|vosotros agacháis}} la cabeza avergonzados.
es.R: Así que esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Mis siervos tendrán comida, pero {{plural_you:ustedes tendrán|vosotros tendréis}} hambre. \q Mis siervos tendrán bebida, pero {{plural_you:ustedes tendrán|vosotros tendréis}} sed. \q Mis siervos estarán alegres, pero {{plural_you:ustedes estarán|vosotros estaréis}} avergonzados.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Tazama, watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watakula, nanyi mtaona njaa; \q tazama, watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watakunywa, nanyi mtaona kiu; \q tazama, watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watafurahi, nanyi mtaaibika.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Tazama, watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watakula huku ninyi mkiona njaa. \q Tazama, watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watakunywa huku ninyi mkiwa na kiu. \q Tazama, watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watafurahi huku ninyi mkiinamisha vichwa kwa aibu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema: Watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watakuwa na chakula, lakini ninyi mtaona njaa. \q Watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watakuwa na kinywaji, lakini ninyi mtaona kiu. \q Watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watafurahi, lakini ninyi mtaaibika.

decisions.choice: my servants and you: two groups within the one people
decisions.reason: The faithful and the rebels are set side by side. Blessing and curse divide them as the covenant warned (Deuteronomy 28; compare Malachi 3:18).

decisions.choice: be ashamed: be put to shame, disgraced when hopes fail
decisions.reason: Shame in Isaiah is the disgrace of those who trusted in what failed them (1:29; 42:17).

decisions.choice: "look" left out
decisions.reason: Readable drops the threefold "look" and keeps the contrasts in short sentences.

source.text: הִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדַ֛י יָרֹ֖נּוּ מִטּ֣וּב לֵ֑ב וְאַתֶּ֤ם תִּצְעֲקוּ֙ מִכְּאֵ֣ב לֵ֔ב וּמִשֵּׁ֥בֶר ר֖וּחַ תְּיֵלִֽילוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, my servants will shout for joy from goodness of heart, and you will cry out from pain of heart, and from brokenness of spirit you will wail.

en.L: Look, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants will shout for joy from goodness of heart, \q and you will cry out from pain of heart, \q and from brokenness of spirit you will wail.
en.B: See, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servants will sing out from hearts full of gladness, \q but you will cry out from hearts full of pain \q and wail because your spirits are crushed.
en.R: My servants will sing because their hearts are happy. \q But you will cry out in pain because your hearts hurt. \q You will cry out in grief because your spirits are crushed.

es.L: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos cantarán de júbilo por la alegría del corazón, \q y {{plural_you:ustedes clamarán|vosotros clamaréis}} por el dolor del corazón, \q y por el quebranto del espíritu {{plural_you:gemirán|gemiréis}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} siervos cantarán con el corazón lleno de alegría, \q pero {{plural_you:ustedes clamarán|vosotros clamaréis}} con el corazón lleno de dolor \q y {{plural_you:gemirán porque su espíritu está quebrantado|gemiréis porque vuestro espíritu está quebrantado}}.
es.R: Mis siervos cantarán porque su corazón está feliz. \q Pero {{plural_you:ustedes gritarán de dolor porque les duele el corazón|vosotros gritaréis de dolor porque os duele el corazón}}. \q {{plural_you:Llorarán con tristeza porque su espíritu está destrozado|Lloraréis con tristeza porque vuestro espíritu está destrozado}}.

sw.L: Tazama, watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wataimba kwa furaha kwa wema wa moyo, \q nanyi mtalia kwa maumivu ya moyo, \q na kwa kuvunjika roho mtapiga yowe.
sw.B: Tazama, watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wataimba kutoka mioyo iliyojaa furaha, \q lakini ninyi mtalia kutoka mioyo iliyojaa maumivu \q na kupiga yowe kwa sababu roho zenu zimepondeka.
sw.R: Watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wataimba kwa sababu mioyo yao ina furaha. \q Lakini ninyi mtalia kwa maumivu kwa sababu mioyo yenu inauma. \q Mtapiga kelele za huzuni kwa sababu roho zenu zimepondeka.

decisions.choice: goodness of heart: a glad heart
decisions.reason: A good heart in this phrase is a happy one (Deuteronomy 28:47; 1 Kings 8:66).

decisions.choice: brokenness of spirit: deep despair
decisions.reason: A broken spirit is one crushed by grief (Proverbs 15:13). Here it is the end of those who forsook God.

source.text: וְהִנַּחְתֶּ֨ם שִׁמְכֶ֤ם לִשְׁבוּעָה֙ לִבְחִירַ֔י וֶהֱמִיתְךָ֖ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וְלַעֲבָדָ֥יו יִקְרָ֖א שֵׁ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will leave your name for a curse to my chosen ones, and the Lord Yahweh will put you to death, and his servants he will call [by] another name,

en.L: And you will leave your name as a curse for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} chosen ones, \q and the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} will put you to death; \q but {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will call [by] another name,
en.B: Your name will live on only as a curse on the lips of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} chosen ones, \q and the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} will put you to death; \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will call {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants by a different name,
en.R: My chosen people will use your name only when they curse someone. \q The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} will put you to death. \q But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants a different name.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:dejarán su nombre|dejaréis vuestro nombre}} como maldición para {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} escogidos, \q y el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:los|os}} matará; \q pero a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} llamará [con] otro nombre,
es.B: {{plural_you:Su nombre|Vuestro nombre}} solo quedará como maldición en boca de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} escogidos, \q y el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dará muerte; \q pero a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los llamará con un nombre distinto,
es.R: Mis escogidos usarán {{plural_you:el nombre de ustedes|vuestro nombre}} solo cuando maldigan a alguien. \q El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dará muerte. \q Pero a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dará un nombre diferente.

sw.L: Nanyi mtaliacha jina lenu kuwa laana kwa wateule {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q na Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} atakuua; \q lakini watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} atawaita [kwa] jina jingine,
sw.B: Jina lenu litabaki tu kama laana vinywani mwa wateule {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q na Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} atawaua; \q lakini watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} atawaita kwa jina tofauti,
sw.R: Watu niliowachagua watalitumia jina lenu tu wanapomlaani mtu. \q Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} atawaua. \q Lakini atawapa watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} jina tofauti.

decisions.choice: leave your name as a curse: your name will be used in curses
decisions.reason: People cursed by naming someone who had come to a bad end (Jeremiah 29:22; compare Zechariah 8:13).

decisions.choice: the Lord GOD will put you to death: what will happen, or the words of the curse itself
alternatives: "So may the Lord GOD kill you!"
decisions.reason: The clause may tell what God will do, or it may give the curse people will speak: "So may the Lord GOD put you to death!"

decisions.choice: another name: a new standing before God
decisions.reason: A new name marks a new relationship with God (62:2, 4; compare Revelation 2:17; 3:12).

source.text: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַמִּתְבָּרֵ֜ךְ בָּאָ֗רֶץ יִתְבָּרֵךְ֙ בֵּאלֹהֵ֣י אָמֵ֔ן וְהַנִּשְׁבָּ֣ע בָּאָ֔רֶץ יִשָּׁבַ֖ע בֵּאלֹהֵ֣י אָמֵ֑ן כִּ֣י נִשְׁכְּח֗וּ הַצָּרוֹת֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנ֔וֹת וְכִ֥י נִסְתְּר֖וּ מֵעֵינָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: so that the [one who] blesses himself in the land will bless himself by the God of amen, and the [one who] swears in the land will swear by the God of amen, for the former troubles will be forgotten and for they will be hidden from my eyes.

en.L: so that whoever blesses himself in the land will bless himself by the God of amen, \q and whoever swears in the land will swear by the God of amen; \q for the former troubles will be forgotten, \q and they will be hidden from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes.
en.B: so that anyone in the land who prays for blessing will pray by the God of Amen, \q and anyone in the land who swears an oath will swear it by the God of Amen. \q The old troubles will be forgotten; \q they will be hidden from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight.
en.R: Anyone in the land who asks for a blessing will ask the God who is faithful and true. \q Anyone who makes a promise will swear by the God who is faithful and true. \q The troubles of the past will be forgotten. \q I will put them out of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight.

es.L: de modo que el que se bendiga en la tierra, se bendecirá por el Dios del amén, \q y el que jure en la tierra, jurará por el Dios del amén; \q porque las angustias primeras serán olvidadas, \q y estarán ocultas de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos.
es.B: de modo que cualquiera en la tierra que pida una bendición la pedirá por el Dios del Amén, \q y cualquiera en la tierra que haga un juramento jurará por el Dios del Amén. \q Las angustias de antes serán olvidadas; \q quedarán ocultas a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos.
es.R: Cualquiera en la tierra que pida una bendición se la pedirá al Dios que es fiel y verdadero. \q Cualquiera que haga una promesa jurará por el Dios que es fiel y verdadero. \q Las angustias del pasado serán olvidadas. \q Las quitaré de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} vista.

sw.L: ili yeye anayejibariki katika nchi ajibariki kwa Mungu wa Amina, \q na yeye anayeapa katika nchi aape kwa Mungu wa Amina; \q kwa maana taabu za kwanza zitasahauliwa, \q nazo zitafichwa machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}.
sw.B: ili yeyote katika nchi anayeomba baraka aombe kwa Mungu wa Amina, \q na yeyote katika nchi anayeapa aape kwa Mungu wa Amina. \q Taabu za zamani zitasahauliwa; \q zitafichwa machoni {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}.
sw.R: Yeyote katika nchi anayeomba baraka atamwomba Mungu aliye mwaminifu na wa kweli. \q Yeyote anayeweka ahadi ataapa kwa Mungu aliye mwaminifu na wa kweli. \q Taabu za zamani zitasahauliwa. \q Nitaziondoa mbele ya macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

decisions.choice: the God of amen: the God who is true and whose word stands
decisions.reason: Amen means "surely, so it is". God is the one who keeps his word (2 Corinthians 1:20; compare Revelation 3:14, where Jesus is "the Amen").

decisions.choice: bless oneself and swear by God: call on him as one's own God
decisions.reason: To ask for blessing or to take an oath by a god's name was to own that god as one's own (Deuteronomy 6:13; Jeremiah 4:2).

decisions.choice: for the former troubles will be forgotten: the reason, and a bridge to verse 17
decisions.reason: The past distress will be gone, so people will gladly call on the faithful God. Verse 17 takes up "former" again.

decisions.choice: the God who is faithful and true; I will put them out of my sight
decisions.reason: Readable explains "amen" (m1) and says what being hidden from God's eyes means.

decisions.choice: Mungu wa Amina (Literal, Balanced); Mungu aliye mwaminifu na wa kweli (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Amen" means "surely, so it is" (meaning decision m1); Literal and Balanced keep the word, familiar in Swahili worship, and Readable says what it means.

source.text: כִּֽי־הִנְנִ֥י בוֹרֵ֛א שָׁמַ֥יִם חֲדָשִׁ֖ים וָאָ֣רֶץ חֲדָשָׁ֑ה וְלֹ֤א תִזָּכַ֨רְנָה֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנ֔וֹת וְלֹ֥א תַעֲלֶ֖ינָה עַל־לֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: For look, I [am] creating new heavens and a new earth, and the former [things] will not be remembered, and they will not come up on [the] heart.

en.L: For look, I [am] creating new heavens and a new earth, \q and the former [things] will not be remembered, \q and they will not come up on [the] heart.
en.B: Look, I am about to create new heavens and a new earth. \q The things of the past will not be remembered; \q no one will even think of them again.
en.R: Look! I am about to create a new heaven and a new earth. \q People will not remember the past or even think about it anymore.

es.L: Porque, {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, yo [estoy] creando cielos nuevos y una tierra nueva, \q y las cosas primeras no serán recordadas, \q ni subirán al corazón.
es.B: {{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, voy a crear cielos nuevos y una tierra nueva. \q Las cosas pasadas no serán recordadas; \q nadie volverá siquiera a pensar en ellas.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}! Voy a crear un cielo nuevo y una tierra nueva. \q La gente no recordará el pasado ni volverá a pensar en él.

sw.L: Kwa maana tazama, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ninaumba mbingu mpya na nchi mpya, \q na mambo ya kwanza hayatakumbukwa, \q wala hayataingia moyoni.
sw.B: Tazama, ninakaribia kuumba mbingu mpya na nchi mpya. \q Mambo ya zamani hayatakumbukwa; \q hakuna atakayeyafikiria tena.
sw.R: Tazama! Ninakaribia kuumba mbingu mpya na nchi mpya. \q Watu hawatakumbuka mambo ya zamani wala kuyafikiria tena.

decisions.choice: I am creating: God is about to create, or is already at work
decisions.reason: The form describes an action under way or about to happen. The verb "create" is used only of God's work (Genesis 1:1; 4:5; 48:7).

decisions.choice: new heavens and a new earth: taken up in 66:22, 2 Peter 3:13 and Revelation 21:1
decisions.reason: The promise is repeated in 66:22. Peter speaks of waiting for new heavens and a new earth, and John sees them in Revelation 21:1.

decisions.choice: come up on the heart: come to mind
decisions.reason: The heart is where a person thinks and remembers (Jeremiah 3:16). The former troubles (verse 16) will be gone even from memory (43:18).

decisions.choice: a new heaven
decisions.reason: Readable uses the singular, as in 66:22, since "heavens" is unusual for a young reader.

decisions.choice: cielos nuevos y una tierra nueva (L, B); un cielo nuevo y una tierra nueva (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets it, following 2 Peter 3:13 (Balanced) and Revelation 21:1 (Readable), so the later quotations can be recognized.

decisions.choice: mbingu mpya na nchi mpya
decisions.reason: The words of Revelation 21:1, which takes up the promise, as the terms note sets them; 66:22 uses the same.

source.text: כִּֽי־אִם־שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְגִ֨ילוּ֙ עֲדֵי־עַ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֣י בוֹרֵ֑א כִּי֩ הִנְנִ֨י בוֹרֵ֧א אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם גִּילָ֖ה וְעַמָּ֥הּ מָשֽׂוֹשׂ׃

records.literal_gloss: But rejoice and be glad until perpetuity [in] what I [am] creating; for look, I [am] creating Jerusalem [as] gladness and its people [as] joy.

en.L: But rejoice and be glad forever [in] what I [am] creating; \q for look, I [am] creating Jerusalem [as] gladness, and its people [as] joy.
en.B: Instead, be joyful and celebrate for all time over what I am creating. \q For look, I am creating Jerusalem to be pure gladness, and its people to be pure joy.
en.R: So be happy and celebrate forever because of what I am creating. \q I am going to make Jerusalem a happy place, and its people will be full of joy.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:gócense y alégrense|gozaos y alegraos}} para siempre [en] lo que yo creo; \q porque, {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, yo creo a Jerusalén [para] alegría, y a su pueblo [para] gozo.
es.B: Más bien, {{plural_you:estén alegres y celebren|estad alegres y celebrad}} para siempre lo que estoy creando. \q Porque, {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, estoy creando a Jerusalén para que sea pura alegría, y a su pueblo para que sea puro gozo.
es.R: Así que {{plural_you:estén felices y celebren|estad felices y celebrad}} para siempre por lo que estoy creando. \q Voy a hacer de Jerusalén un lugar feliz, y su pueblo estará lleno de gozo.

sw.L: Lakini furahini na kushangilia milele [katika] yale ninayoyaumba; \q kwa maana tazama, ninaumba Yerusalemu [kuwa] shangwe, na watu wake [kuwa] furaha.
sw.B: Badala yake, furahini na kusherehekea nyakati zote juu ya yale ninayoyaumba. \q Kwa maana tazama, ninaumba Yerusalemu kuwa shangwe tupu, na watu wake kuwa furaha tupu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo furahini na kusherehekea milele kwa sababu ya yale ninayoyaumba. \q Nitaufanya Yerusalemu kuwa mahali pa furaha, na watu wake watajawa na furaha.

decisions.choice: but rather: instead of remembering the past, rejoice
decisions.reason: The words set the gladness against the forgotten troubles of verse 17.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem as gladness: the city and its people become joy itself
decisions.reason: The city will not only be glad; it will be the source and picture of gladness (62:4-5; 60:15).

decisions.choice: pure gladness; pure joy
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "pure" to carry the force of calling the city gladness itself (m2).

source.text: וְגַלְתִּ֥י בִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְשַׂשְׂתִּ֣י בְעַמִּ֑י וְלֹֽא־יִשָּׁמַ֥ע בָּהּ֙ ע֔וֹד ק֥וֹל בְּכִ֖י וְק֥וֹל זְעָקָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will be glad in Jerusalem and rejoice in my people, and there will not be heard in it again a sound of weeping and a sound of a cry.

en.L: And I will be glad in Jerusalem and rejoice in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, \q and there will not be heard in it again a sound of weeping and a sound of crying.
en.B: I will be glad over Jerusalem and delight in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people. \q No sound of weeping, no cry for help, will be heard in it again.
en.R: I will be happy with Jerusalem and glad about {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people. \q People there will never again weep or cry out for help.

es.L: Y me alegraré en Jerusalén y me gozaré en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, \q y no se oirá más en ella voz de llanto ni voz de clamor.
es.B: Me alegraré por Jerusalén y me deleitaré en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo. \q No se oirá más en ella ruido de llanto ni grito de auxilio.
es.R: Estaré feliz con Jerusalén y contento con {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo. \q La gente de allí nunca más llorará ni gritará pidiendo ayuda.

sw.L: Nami nitafurahi katika Yerusalemu na kushangilia katika watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q wala haitasikika ndani yake tena sauti ya kilio na sauti ya kulia.
sw.B: Nitafurahi juu ya Yerusalemu na kupendezwa na watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Hakuna sauti ya kilio wala ya kuomba msaada itakayosikika ndani yake tena.
sw.R: Nitafurahi pamoja na Yerusalemu na kufurahia watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Watu huko hawatalia tena wala kupiga kelele kuomba msaada.

decisions.choice: I will be glad in Jerusalem: God shares the joy of his people
decisions.reason: God himself rejoices over his people (62:5; Zephaniah 3:17).

decisions.choice: no more weeping: echoed in Revelation 21:4
decisions.reason: Isaiah promised that God would wipe away tears (25:8; 35:10). Revelation 21:4 takes up the promise for the new creation.

decisions.choice: cry: a cry of distress, calling for help
decisions.reason: The word is the outcry of the oppressed (Exodus 3:9; 5:7).

source.text: לֹא־יִֽהְיֶ֨ה מִשָּׁ֜ם ע֗וֹד ע֤וּל יָמִים֙ וְזָקֵ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יְמַלֵּ֖א אֶת־יָמָ֑יו כִּ֣י הַנַּ֗עַר בֶּן־מֵאָ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ יָמ֔וּת וְהַ֣חוֹטֶ֔א בֶּן־מֵאָ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה יְקֻלָּֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: There will not be from there again a sucking child of days, and an old [man] who does not fill out his days, for the youth a son of a hundred years will die, and the [one who] misses a son of a hundred years will be cursed.

en.L: There will no longer be from there an infant [who lives only a few] days, \q or an old [man] who does not fill out his days; \q for the youth will die [at] 100 years, \q and the one who falls short of 100 years will be cursed.
en.B: There will be no more babies there who live just a few days, \q and no old people who fail to complete their years. \q Someone who dies at 100 will die as a youth, \q and one who falls short of 100 will be held to be under a curse.
en.R: Babies will no longer die when they are only a few days old. \q Old people will live long, full lives. \q A person who dies at 100 will be thought of as young. \q Anyone who does not live to be 100 will seem to be under a curse.

es.L: No habrá más allí niño de pecho [que viva pocos] días, \q ni anciano que no complete sus días; \q porque el joven morirá [a los] cien años, \q y el que no llegue a los cien años será maldito.
es.B: No habrá allí más bebés que vivan solo unos pocos días, \q ni ancianos que no completen sus años. \q El que muera a los cien años morirá joven, \q y el que no llegue a los cien será tenido por maldito.
es.R: Los bebés ya no morirán cuando tengan solo unos días de vida. \q Los ancianos vivirán vidas largas y completas. \q A quien muera a los cien años se le considerará joven. \q Cualquiera que no llegue a los cien años parecerá estar bajo una maldición.

sw.L: Hapatakuwa tena huko mtoto mchanga [anayeishi] siku [chache], \q wala mzee asiyetimiza siku zake; \q kwa maana kijana atakufa [akiwa na] miaka mia, \q na yule asiyefikia miaka mia atahesabiwa amelaaniwa.
sw.B: Hakutakuwa tena huko na watoto wachanga wanaoishi siku chache tu, \q wala wazee wasiotimiza miaka yao. \q Mtu atakayekufa akiwa na miaka mia atakufa akiwa kijana, \q na yule asiyefikia miaka mia atahesabiwa kuwa chini ya laana.
sw.R: Watoto wachanga hawatakufa tena wakiwa na siku chache tu. \q Wazee wataishi maisha marefu na kamili. \q Mtu atakayekufa akiwa na miaka mia atahesabiwa kuwa kijana. \q Yeyote asiyefikia miaka mia ataonekana kuwa chini ya laana.

decisions.choice: the one who misses a hundred years: the one who falls short of a hundred
alternatives: the sinner, a hundred years old, will be cursed
decisions.reason: The verb means to miss the mark (Judges 20:16), and it most often means to sin. Read beside "the youth", it is the one who misses reaching a hundred; dying younger would be taken as a sign of curse. Others read "the sinner a hundred years old will be cursed".

decisions.choice: fill out his days: live a full life
decisions.reason: To fill one's days is to reach the full length of life (Exodus 23:26).

decisions.choice: the youth will die at a hundred: long life in the new age
decisions.reason: Death is not yet said to be gone, but life is so long that a hundred years counts as young. Long life was a covenant blessing (Deuteronomy 5:33); 25:8 promises death swallowed up.

decisions.choice: held (seem) to be under a curse
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that an early death would be taken as a sign of curse (m1).

source.text: וּבָנ֥וּ בָתִּ֖ים וְיָשָׁ֑בוּ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְאָכְל֖וּ פִּרְיָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will build houses and dwell, and they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

en.L: And they will build houses and dwell [in them]; \q and they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
en.B: They will build houses and settle in them, \q plant vineyards and enjoy their grapes.
en.R: They will build houses and live in them. \q They will plant vineyards and eat the grapes.

es.L: Y edificarán casas y [las] habitarán; \q y plantarán viñas y comerán su fruto.
es.B: Construirán casas y vivirán en ellas, \q plantarán viñas y disfrutarán de sus uvas.
es.R: Construirán casas y vivirán en ellas. \q Plantarán viñas y comerán las uvas.

sw.L: Nao watajenga nyumba na kukaa [ndani yake]; \q nao watapanda mizabibu na kula matunda yake.
sw.B: Watajenga nyumba na kuishi ndani yake, \q watapanda mizabibu na kufurahia zabibu zake.
sw.R: Watajenga nyumba na kuishi ndani yake. \q Watapanda mizabibu na kula zabibu zake.

decisions.choice: build and dwell, plant and eat: the curse reversed
decisions.reason: The covenant curse said others would live in the houses and eat the vineyards of the unfaithful (Deuteronomy 28:30; compare 62:8-9; Amos 9:14).

source.text: לֹ֤א יִבְנוּ֙ וְאַחֵ֣ר יֵשֵׁ֔ב לֹ֥א יִטְּע֖וּ וְאַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל כִּֽי־כִימֵ֤י הָעֵץ֙ יְמֵ֣י עַמִּ֔י וּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵיהֶ֖ם יְבַלּ֥וּ בְחִירָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: They will not build and another dwell; they will not plant and another eat; for like the days of the tree [will be] the days of my people, and the work of their hands my chosen ones will wear out.

en.L: They will not build and another dwell [there]; \q they will not plant and another eat; \q for like the days of the tree [will be] the days of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, \q and the work of their hands {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} chosen ones will wear out.
en.B: They will not build for others to live in, \q or plant for others to eat. \q The lifetime of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people will be like the lifetime of a tree, \q and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} chosen ones will use the work of their own hands to the very end.
en.R: They will not build houses that strangers take over. \q They will not plant crops that someone else eats. \q My people will live as long as trees. \q The people I have chosen will enjoy what they make for a long, long time.

es.L: No edificarán para que otro habite; \q no plantarán para que otro coma; \q porque como los días del árbol [serán] los días de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, \q y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} escogidos gastarán la obra de sus manos.
es.B: No construirán para que otros vivan allí, \q ni plantarán para que otros coman. \q La vida de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo será tan larga como la vida de un árbol, \q y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} escogidos disfrutarán hasta el final la obra de sus propias manos.
es.R: No construirán casas de las que otros se adueñen. \q No plantarán cosechas que otro se coma. \q Mi pueblo vivirá tanto como los árboles. \q La gente que he escogido disfrutará de lo que hace durante mucho, mucho tiempo.

sw.L: Hawatajenga na mwingine akae [humo]; \q hawatapanda na mwingine ale; \q kwa maana kama siku za mti [ndivyo zitakavyokuwa] siku za watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q na kazi ya mikono yao wateule {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wataitumia mpaka ichakae.
sw.B: Hawatajenga ili wengine waishi humo, \q wala hawatapanda ili wengine wale. \q Maisha ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} yatakuwa marefu kama maisha ya mti, \q na wateule {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} watatumia kazi ya mikono yao wenyewe mpaka mwisho kabisa.
sw.R: Hawatajenga nyumba ambazo wageni watazichukua. \q Hawatapanda mazao ambayo mtu mwingine atayala. \q Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wataishi muda mrefu kama miti. \q Watu niliowachagua watafurahia vitu wanavyovitengeneza kwa muda mrefu sana.

decisions.choice: like the days of a tree: a long life
decisions.reason: Trees outlive people by many years (Psalm 92:13-15; Job 14:7). The Septuagint has "the tree of life".

decisions.choice: wear out: use to the full, enjoy until it is worn out
decisions.reason: The verb means to wear out, as clothes do (50:9). They will live long enough to use up what they make.

decisions.choice: houses; crops
decisions.reason: Readable names what they build and plant.

source.text: לֹ֤א יִֽיגְעוּ֙ לָרִ֔יק וְלֹ֥א יֵלְד֖וּ לַבֶּהָלָ֑ה כִּ֣י זֶ֜רַע בְּרוּכֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ הֵ֔מָּה וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֖ם אִתָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: They will not toil for emptiness, and they will not bear for terror, for offspring of [the] blessed of Yahweh [are] they, and their descendants with them.

en.L: They will not toil for nothing, \q and they will not bear [children] for terror; \q for they [are] offspring of [those] blessed of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and their descendants with them.
en.B: Their work will not be wasted, \q nor will they bring children into the world for sudden ruin; \q for they are the offspring of those {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed, \q and their own children with them.
en.R: Their hard work will not be wasted. \q They will not have children only to see them meet with sudden disaster. \q They and their children will be people that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed.

es.L: No trabajarán en vano, \q ni darán a luz para el terror; \q porque son descendencia de los benditos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y sus vástagos con ellos.
es.B: Su trabajo no será en vano, \q ni traerán hijos al mundo para una ruina repentina; \q porque son descendencia de los que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha bendecido, \q y sus propios hijos con ellos.
es.R: Su duro trabajo no será en vano. \q No tendrán hijos solo para verlos sufrir un desastre repentino. \q Ellos y sus hijos serán gente bendecida por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Hawatataabika bure, \q wala hawatazaa [watoto] kwa ajili ya maafa; \q kwa maana wao [ni] uzao wa [wale] waliobarikiwa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na wazao wao pamoja nao.
sw.B: Kazi yao haitapotea bure, \q wala hawatazaa watoto ili wapatwe na maangamizi ya ghafula; \q kwa maana wao ni uzao wa wale ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewabariki, \q pamoja na watoto wao wenyewe.
sw.R: Kazi yao ngumu haitapotea bure. \q Hawatazaa watoto ili tu wawaone wakipatwa na msiba wa ghafula. \q Wao na watoto wao watakuwa watu ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewabariki.

decisions.choice: terror: sudden disaster that brings dread
decisions.reason: The word is used of sudden calamity sent as a curse (Leviticus 26:16; Psalm 78:33).

decisions.choice: toil and children: the covenant curse reversed
decisions.reason: The curse said the fruit of their labor and their children would be taken (Deuteronomy 28:32-33, 41). Here the offspring are blessed, as 61:9 promised.

source.text: וְהָיָ֥ה טֶֽרֶם־יִקְרָ֖אוּ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶעֱנֶ֑ה ע֛וֹד הֵ֥ם מְדַבְּרִ֖ים וַאֲנִ֥י אֶשְׁמָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, before they call, and I will answer; still they [are] speaking, and I will hear.

en.L: And it will be [that] before they call, I will answer; \q [while] they [are] still speaking, I will hear.
en.B: It will happen that I answer them before they call, \q and hear them while the words are still on their lips.
en.R: I will answer them before they even call to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q While they are still speaking, I will already be listening.

es.L: Y sucederá [que] antes que clamen, yo responderé; \q [mientras] aún estén hablando, yo habré oído.
es.B: Sucederá que les responderé antes de que clamen, \q y los oiré mientras las palabras aún estén en sus labios.
es.R: Les responderé aun antes de que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llamen. \q Mientras todavía estén hablando, ya los estaré escuchando.

sw.L: Na itakuwa kwamba kabla hawajaita, nitajibu; \q [wakati] wangali wanasema, nitasikia.
sw.B: Itakuwa kwamba nitawajibu kabla hawajaita, \q na kuwasikia wakati maneno yangali vinywani mwao.
sw.R: Nitawajibu hata kabla hawajaniita. \q Wakati bado wanaongea, tayari nitakuwa ninasikiliza.

decisions.choice: before they call, I will answer: the end of the silence
decisions.reason: In the prayer God seemed silent (64:11), and to the rebels he said, "I called and you did not answer" (65:12). For his servants he answers even before they ask (58:9; compare Matthew 6:8).

source.text: זְאֵ֨ב וְטָלֶ֜ה יִרְע֣וּ כְאֶחָ֗ד וְאַרְיֵה֙ כַּבָּקָ֣ר יֹֽאכַל־תֶּ֔בֶן וְנָחָ֖שׁ עָפָ֣ר לַחְמ֑וֹ לֹֽא־יָרֵ֧עוּ וְלֹֽא־יַשְׁחִ֛יתוּ בְּכָל־הַ֥ר קָדְשִׁ֖י אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Wolf and lamb will graze as one, and the lion like the ox will eat straw, and the snake, dust [is] its food; they will not do harm and they will not destroy in all the mountain of my holiness, says Yahweh.

en.L: The wolf and the lamb will graze as one, and the lion like the ox will eat straw, \q and [as for] the snake, dust [will be] its food. \q They will not do harm and they will not destroy in all the mountain of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holiness, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Wolf and lamb will graze side by side, the lion will eat straw as the ox does, \q and the snake will live on dust. \q None will hurt and none will destroy anywhere on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Wolves and lambs will eat grass together. Lions will eat straw just as oxen do. \q And snakes will eat dust. \q There will be no harm and no destruction anywhere on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: El lobo y el cordero pacerán juntos, y el león como el buey comerá paja, \q y [en cuanto a] la serpiente, el polvo [será] su alimento. \q No harán daño ni destruirán en todo el monte de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santidad, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: El lobo y el cordero pastarán uno al lado del otro, el león comerá paja como el buey, \q y la serpiente se alimentará de polvo. \q Nadie hará daño y nadie destruirá en todo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} monte santo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Los lobos y los corderos comerán pasto juntos. Los leones comerán paja como los bueyes. \q Y las serpientes comerán polvo. \q No habrá daño ni destrucción en ninguna parte de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} monte santo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Mbwa mwitu na mwana-kondoo watalisha pamoja, na simba kama ng'ombe atakula majani makavu, \q na [kuhusu] nyoka, mavumbi [yatakuwa] chakula chake. \q Hawatadhuru wala hawataharibu katika mlima wote wa utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mbwa mwitu na mwana-kondoo watalisha kando kwa kando, simba atakula majani makavu kama ng'ombe, \q na nyoka ataishi kwa mavumbi. \q Hakuna atakayedhuru wala kuharibu popote katika mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mbwa mwitu na wana-kondoo watakula majani pamoja. Simba watakula majani makavu kama ng'ombe. \q Na nyoka watakula mavumbi. \q Hakutakuwa na madhara wala uharibifu popote katika mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: the wolf and the lamb: Isaiah 11:6-9 taken up again
decisions.reason: The verse repeats the picture of 11:6-9, with the lion eating straw (11:7) and the closing line almost word for word (11:9). The peace promised under the coming king belongs to the new creation.

decisions.choice: dust will be the snake's food: the word to the serpent in Eden
decisions.reason: In Genesis 3:14 the serpent is told it will eat dust. In the new creation the snake keeps to its dust and harms no one.

decisions.choice: my holy mountain: Zion, and the land where God reigns
decisions.reason: As in 11:9 and 56:7, the holy mountain is the place of God's rule, here widened to the renewed world.

decisions.choice: the wording of 11:6-9 where the Hebrew is the same
decisions.reason: The verse gathers lines from Isaiah 11:6-9: "el león como el buey comerá paja" (11:7) and "No harán daño ni destruirán en todo el monte de mi santidad" (11:9) keep the Spanish of those verses at each level; the rest follows the Hebrew of this verse.

decisions.choice: the lion line and the closing line in the wording of 11:7 and 11:9
decisions.reason: The verse takes up 11:6-9 (meaning decision m1). Where the Hebrew is the same (the lion eating straw like the ox, 11:7; "they will not harm or destroy in all my holy mountain", 11:9) each level takes the Swahili of chapter 11; the wolf and lamb grazing together and the snake's dust differ in Hebrew and are worded afresh.
